Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> is analyzing the reason for the quest's failure.

Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>正在分析原因。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>正在分析原因。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, qui a échoué dans sa mission, en analyse la raison.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> analysiert den Grund für das Scheitern der Mission.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> analiza la causa del fracaso de la misión.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Depois de falhar na missão, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> está analisando a causa.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> กำลังวิเคราะห์สาเหตุของความล้มเหลวในการทำภารกิจ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Menganalisis penyebab kegagalan <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> (dia) melakukan analisis penyebab kegagalan.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đang phân tích lý do nhiệm vụ thất bại.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> मिशन की विफलता के कारण का विश्लेषण कर रहा है।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: All right. Let's do better next time.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: よし、次はうまくやろう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: D'accord. Faisons mieux la prochaine fois.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: In Ordnung. Versuchen wir es beim nächsten Mal besser.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Está bien. Hagámoslo mejor la próxima vez.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Certo. Vamos nos sair melhor da próxima vez.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ตกลงค่ะ ครั้งหน้าจะทำให้ดีกว่านี้
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Baiklah. Mari kita lakukan lebih baik lain kali.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Được rồi. Lần tới chúng ta sẽ làm tốt hơn.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: ठीक है। अगली बार बेहतर करते हैं।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを半分こしよう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Vamos compartilhar uma Poção de Vitalidade.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: แบ่งยาเพิ่มพลังชีวิตกัน
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Cùng nhau uống bình thuốc Sức Sống.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: एक वाइटैलिटी पोशन साझा करते हैं।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 표정은 그대로였지만, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>의 눈이 반짝였던 것 같다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Though her face didn't change, I saw a glimmer in <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>'s eyes.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 表情は変わらなかったが、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>の目が輝いたように見えた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 表情虽然没变，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的眼睛似乎闪闪发亮。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 表情雖然沒變，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的眼睛似乎閃閃發亮。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Bien que son visage n'ait pas changé, j'ai cru voir une lueur dans les yeux de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Obwohl ihr Gesichtsausdruck unverändert blieb, schienen <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>s Augen zu glänzen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Aunque su rostro no cambió, vi un brillo en los ojos de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Embora seu rosto não tenha mudado, os olhos de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> pareciam brilhar.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แม้สีหน้าของ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> จะไม่เปลี่ยนไป แต่ฉันคิดว่าดวงตาของเธอเป็นประกาย
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Meskipun ekspresinya tidak berubah, mata <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tampak berkilau.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Dù biểu cảm không thay đổi, nhưng tôi thấy mắt <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lóe lên một tia sáng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: "चेहरा वही रहा, लेकिन <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>की आँखों में चमक दिखी।"

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 실패가 마음에 걸렸는지, 돌아오는 내내 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 고개를 떨구고 있었다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> kept her head down all the way back. Maybe the failure weighed on her more than I thought.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 帰り道。失敗を引きずっているのか、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はずっとうつむいていた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 似乎对失败耿耿于怀，回程一路上<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>都低着头。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 似乎對失敗耿耿於懷，回程一路上<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>都低著頭。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a gardé la tête baissée tout le long du chemin du retour. L'échec lui pesait peut-être plus que je ne le pensais.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hatte auf dem ganzen Rückweg den Kopf gesenkt. Vielleicht nagte der Misserfolg mehr an ihr, als ich dachte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mantuvo la cabeza baja todo el camino de regreso. Quizás el fracaso le afectó más de lo que pensé.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Talvez a falha a tenha afetado mais do que eu pensava, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> manteve a cabeça baixa durante todo o caminho de volta.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ความล้มเหลวคงติดอยู่ในใจ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> เลยก้มหน้าตลอดทางกลับ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menundukkan kepalanya sepanjang perjalanan pulang. Mungkin kegagalan itu lebih membebani dirinya daripada yang kukira.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> cứ cúi đầu suốt đường về. Có lẽ thất bại đó ảnh hưởng đến cô bé nhiều hơn tôi nghĩ.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> वापस आते समय पूरे रास्ते सिर झुकाए रही। शायद विफलता ने उसे मेरी सोच से ज़्यादा परेशान किया।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est égayée après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hellte sich auf, nachdem sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> สดใสขึ้นหลังจากได้รับยา
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menjadi ceria setelah menerima ramuan itu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã vui vẻ trở lại sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: पोशन मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> का चेहरा खिल उठा।
